subject.title: Memory MVP: implement source attribution and provenance model

question: What native durable-memory provenance contract should OpenClaw use across memory-core, QMD, MEMORY.md promotion, Memory Wiki bridge inputs, and review/edit flows?
rationale: The source-level gap is clear, but the durable data model, source authority semantics, cross-plugin boundary, and migration/review behavior require maintainer product direction before implementation.

options.title: Define native provenance contract
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical provenance tracker and define structured source refs, lineage, and source-required promotion before coding.

options.title: Fold into schema foundation first
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/42646 as the schema prerequisite, then implement this issue once record and revision ownership are settled.

options.title: Leave provenance to Memory Wiki for now
options.body: Document Memory Wiki as the provenance-rich optional layer while leaving active memory's native promotion and retrieval contracts unchanged for the moment.

recommendation.title: Define native provenance contract
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical provenance tracker and define structured source refs, lineage, and source-required promotion before coding.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest available routing signal for the memory host SDK, memory-core contract boundary, docs, and prior review context.
